text:
alex: Quick sync — PulseBridge instrumentation handoff. Who's owning final event schema + token-attrib mapping? Need to lock before we can canary (aiming Weds).

priya: I'm taking schema ownership. PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/pulsebridge-schema/pulls/842 — small change: add `user_tier` (string) and optional `kv_prefix`. Asking for ingest contract review from @samir.

samir: I can review. Saw one failing test in ingest-runner that looks related to the new optional field. Will push a fix today (EOD). Also FYI eng-ml needs the `kv_prefix` in the forwarder payload — @kevin can you confirm that patch window?

kevin: Confirmed — eng-ml team will ship a tiny forwarder change tomorrow morning (PR coming). Also ran a quick latency sim: quantization proxy + prefix handling adds ~2ms median and ~5ms p99 in our dev harness. We should capture that in the latency breakdown so SRE/owners have visibility.

alex: Good point. Can we get a short smoke-test checklist I can run after CI? I'll only cut canary if everything passes. Proposed checklist:
```
1) Schema PR merged + schema validate job green
2) Ingest e2e smoke (sample msgs -> enriched events)
3) Latency samples collected (p50/p95/p99) with new breakdown fields
4) Token cost mapping verified against sample traces
5) Canary dashboard + alert thresholds set
```

priya: Adding the checklist to the PR description and to the handbook page. Also adding a minimal eval prompt set to catch regressions on token attribution. Link in PR.

samir: Pushed fix -> https://git.internal/redwood/ingest-runner/pulls/849. CI is green except one flaky integration test — retriggered. @deploy-bot can you kick the ingest-smoke job when you see this?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Nightly job triggered for ingest-smoke. job id: job-5621. ETA ~12m. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/job-5621/logs

alex: Thanks all. If CI and smoke look good I'll cut a canary build and tag owners. Tentative rollout Thurs morning if no surprises.

kevin: One more ask — add `kvcache_hit_rate` metric to the canary dashboard so we can explain token cost variance during the rollout.

priya: Will add metric + example query to the PR. Also pinged finance (morgan) for cost mapping sign-off.

samir: Re CI: integration flake resolved after retrigger. Everything green now. Ready for canary once eng-ml patch merges.

alex: Perfect. I'll wait for eng-ml PR then trigger the canary and post results here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup:
